# MOCK PNG TRANSCRIPT FIXTURE
# This is a placeholder for a sample PNG transcript
# In a real scenario, this would be an actual PNG image file

Note: This file represents a PNG image of a transcript.
PNG is the preferred format for OCR due to lossless compression.

Image specifications:
- Format: PNG (lossless)
- Resolution: 300 DPI
- Size: 2480 x 3508 pixels (A4 at 300 DPI)
- Color: Grayscale or color with high contrast
